dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the former generations of the Order of Skeptics...

dialogues.speaker: Zurvan
dialogues.text: They claimed to be those that once fought side by side with the heroes of Dahri.

dialogues.speaker: Zurvan
dialogues.text: Although I never met any Dahri aside from that swordsman, any who face the beasts of corruption stands as our ally.

dialogues.speaker: Zurvan
dialogues.text: Our battle against the defilement will continue on forever. In the face of such an ever-lasting conflict, the regards of humanity is meaningless.
